verifiedRepositorySemantics: normalizeEnrichmentPayload preserves custom per-stock objects as supplied while dropping payload-level provenance metadata.
fetchEnrichment merges custom stock fields over its earlier enrichment object; mergeEnrichment spreads arbitrary extra fields into market rows.
runAfterMarketScan later overlays TDCC/FINANCIAL/VALUATION/ANNOUNCEMENTS per-symbol objects only when those objects have the symbol.
announcementsVerified is then assigned globally from announcements.sourcesVerified===true.
Therefore a missing canonical FINANCIAL or VALUATION symbol entry does not itself clear same-named fields already present on the row.

structuralCounterexample.postOverlayConsequence: No FINANCIAL/VALUATION symbol object exists to overwrite or clear the pre-existing fields; announcementsVerified becomes true globally.
structuralCounterexample.formalConsequence: The bundled Formal field-completeness expression can pass even though current canonical FINANCIAL/VALUATION symbol membership is absent.
structuralCounterexample.interpretation: This proves technical feasibility only. It does not prove live production prevalence or that alternate fields are invalid.

estimands.canonicalSourceCompleteness: Current official FINANCIAL symbol entry complete + current official VALUATION symbol entry complete + announcement sources verified.
estimands.formalMergedFieldCompleteness: The exact seven required fields as seen by scoreCandidate after all merges.
estimands.requiredSeparation: Report both. Do not use canonical source-missing rate as a direct estimate of Formal reject rate.

invariant.statement: On current overlay order, canonical source complete should imply merged Formal field complete for this gate.
invariant.violationMeaning: Version/order/observer mismatch or later mutation; investigate before using the row.

pitGuard: Neither current mutable quality snapshots nor custom enrichment path proves immutable first-known historical provenance. Historical outcome inference remains closed.
exactNext: Freeze prospective dual-state capture: pre-quality field presence, official FINANCIAL/VALUATION symbol membership, announcement source verification, post-overlay exact Formal fields, parent generation/fingerprint.
Require immutable same-generation capture before estimating FIELD_PASS_SOURCE_GAP frequency.
Do not clear alternate fields or change Formal merge precedence without Class-C approval.
